selection_rule.preflight: ROLE_NOT_PERMITTED is selected before reading payload for a disallowed action.
selection_rule.wire: After an allowed action, lower numeric priority wins. UTF-8, BOM, line-ending, envelope, and header checks precede row fields.
selection_rule.same_priority: Within one row, validate fields in month, building, kwh order; across rows use ascending physical record order.
selection_rule.batch_order: Validate the complete payload before duplicate or replay checks; the first applicable category by priority wins.
selection_rule.state: Every listed rejection is fail-closed and leaves the pre-import state unchanged.

csv_contract.bom: BOM is not accepted at the start or anywhere in the payload; return INVALID_CSV_BOM.
csv_contract.rfc4180: Comma delimiter and ordinary double-quote field quoting are accepted; doubled quotes follow RFC 4180; embedded LF/CRLF inside a quoted field is rejected as INVALID_ROW_SHAPE; backslash is not an escape.
csv_contract.line_endings: LF and CRLF are each accepted as record separators; bare CR and mixed LF/CRLF are rejected.
csv_contract.blank_records: Blank records are INVALID_ROW_SHAPE; one terminal record separator is allowed; header-only is EMPTY_DATASET.

building_contract.control_characters: All C0 controls, DEL, whitespace padding, and embedded CR/LF are rejected.

codes.trigger: Reviewer import/replay or any role action outside the matrix.
codes.state_effect: No state mutation; reject before CSV parsing.

codes.trigger: Input bytes are not valid UTF-8.
A UTF-8 BOM appears at the start or anywhere in the payload; BOM is never accepted.
Bare CR or mixed LF/CRLF record endings.
Header is not exactly month,building,kwh after UTF-8 decoding; BOM is handled by INVALID_CSV_BOM.
A valid header has no data record.
RFC 4180 parse error, wrong field count, blank record, embedded field newline, or malformed quote.
Month is not a valid YYYY-MM calendar token.
Building is empty, non-ASCII/disallowed, over 64 characters, whitespace-padded, or contains a control character after CSV parsing.
Kwh is a signed negative decimal token.
Kwh is decimal but has more than three fractional digits.
Kwh is empty, plus-signed, exponent-form, non-decimal, or whitespace-padded.
Two rows share one (month,building) key within a batch.
Existing dataset_id has the same canonical sorted rows.
codes.state_effect: No state mutation; existing history remains unchanged.

codes.trigger: Existing dataset_id has different canonical sorted rows.
codes.state_effect: No state mutation; existing history remains unchanged.

codes.trigger: Direct edit/delete/recompute of accepted or derived history.
An operation attempts to overwrite or delete an accepted record.
